title: SprintWatch microrun playbook: rollout compass & quick-run checklist (May 2026)
content:
Overview:
- Compact runbook for SprintWatch microrun during the week of May 11-17, 2026.
- Purpose: ship a model-routing policy update with minimal blast radius; include a practical checklist, calendar milestones, and a short release notes draft for post-approval.
- Scope: routing-by-cost fallback + batcher configuration changes targeted at short-prompt latency.

Goals:
- Confirm fallback to quantized variant under stress without customer-visible failures.
- Maintain latency SLOs: p50/p95/p99 targets monitored for 72h post-canary.
- Keep user-facing error rate under 0.05% during canary; auto-rollback if sustained above 0.2% for 10 minutes.

Preflight (staging) checklist - owners in parentheses:
- Run staging integration smoke: metrics and alert pipeline (Jonas).
- Validate end-to-end tracing and sampling configuration (Priya).
- Dry run canary harness with golden prompts (Ethan).
- Warm KV cache locally and confirm cache hit-rate baseline (Marta).
- Lint and k8s-dry-run the canary manifests (Aisha).

Calendar highlights:
- Day -2 (May 9): final runthrough, confirm pager roster and comms play. Deploy staging flag for dry-run.
- Day -1 (May 10): freeze non-essential changes 00:00-18:00 UTC. Verify alerts tuned. Tag GH infra artifact for canary.

Canary plan (May 11 08:00 UTC -> May 13 20:00 UTC):
Phase A (1% traffic, 08:00-14:00):
- Deploy routing flag to 1% of traffic.
- Execute synthetic perturbation (spike, cold-starts) for 30 minutes.
- Wait 60 minutes steady-state and review p50/p95/p99.
- Rollback immediately if error-rate >0.2% for 10m.

Phase B (10% traffic, 14:00-02:00):
- Ramp to 10% if Phase A is green.
- Enable light trace sampling (5%).
- Run a 120-prompt golden test set; threshold: fuzzy match >= 0.82.
- Pause if quality regression >3% across suite.

Phase C (50% and soak, next day 08:00-20:00):
- Ramp to 50% only if metrics within guardrails.
- Soak for 12 hours; review cost delta and SLOs.

Full ramp (earliest May 14, low-traffic window 03:00-05:00 UTC):
- Schedule staggered service restarts where necessary.
- Post-ramp verification for 6 hours.

Rollback cheat-sheet:
1) Flip the feature-gate flag back to stable via the feature-gates service.
2) If config-only, revert the config commit and restart rollout agent.
3) If infra fix required, follow the infra fastpatch template.
4) Notify channels: #ops-rollouts, oncall@redwood, product owners. Create incident link referencing RE-4128.

Observability signals to watch (links above):
- Error rate by route/model - alert at 0.2% sustained over 10m.
- p99 latency for short prompts (<256 tokens) - target 1200ms.
- Token-cost trend and 1h rolling delta.
- Trace sampling results for tail-latency hotspots.
- Daily golden-prompt regression snapshot.

Draft release notes (for product writer):
- Change: routing policy now prefers lower-cost compatible variants during high-concurrency loads, with automatic safety fallbacks.
- Rationale: reduce p95/p99 latency for short prompts and improve token spend efficiency during bursts.
- Expected impact: 6-12% token spend reduction for high-concurrency cases; improved p95 for short prompts. No customer schema changes.
- Rollout: staged canary 1% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% over ~72h with telemetry gating.
- Rollback: immediate revert available; incident RE-4128 if triggered.

Open items / decisions required:
- Add per-enterprise latency-only telemetry behind a flag? Decision by May 8.
- Product-owner signoff for final golden prompt set (Priya).
- Ops decision: temporarily increase sampling to 10% during Phase B if noise low.

Action items:
- Prepare a short support runbook summarizing likely user-visible symptoms (Aisha).
- Draft customer comms for reserved capacity customers (Priya).
- Publish final checklist and calendar on Confluence (Jonas).

Field notes / reminders (informal):
- Keep canary harness minimal; avoid new services during canary.
- If token-cost increases but latency improves, call product to evaluate tradeoffs.
- Assemble debugging kit: kdump scripts, heap export steps, sample request ID list and keep it in releases/RE-4128/debug-kit.

Snippets (examples):
- Feature flag flip example: request the feature-gate service UI or internal CLI to set the route-policy back to stable.
- Canary manifest check: run a k8s dry-run locally before applying.
- Golden prompt runner: run the short_prompt suite against canary environment with existing infra tooling.

Revision log:
- 2026-05-04: initial playbook draft (Aisha).
- 2026-05-05: added rollback cheat-sheet and observability signals (Jonas).
- 2026-05-06: updated ramp percentages per infra sync (Priya).
